If you picked up a new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone Duo this fall, or you’re shopping for someone with an iPad, AirPods, or Apple Watch, there’s a good chance you’ve been holding out on purchasing accessories until all of the Black Friday deals started. We’ve got you covered with some great deals on premium accessories for nearly every Apple device on your list.

ESR has been making Apple accessories since 2009, and that track record has made it a trustworthy name for the more than 123 million people who use its products to protect their Apple devices and make them more versatile. Here’s a look at what’s included in ESR’s Black Friday lineup and who each one is for.
